reason: We do the free zoo on Saturdays and it works fine. I'd maybe use the free first visit, but $15 a kid every weekend for a play room feels like a lot when the zoo costs nothing.
objection: $15 a visit for something that is basically toys and a coffee, when my Saturday outing is already free. It also feels a bit Instagram for Salisbury.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in closer to $8-10, or a weekend-friendly pack that makes each visit cheap, plus a rainy-day Saturday where the zoo is out.
